itr_form_reasoning: Only salary income (from two employers, combined) plus small savings interest; no capital gains, no business income, total income well under Rs 50 lakh. ITR-1 applies, but the two-employer combination must be done manually in the 'Salary' schedule -- the portal does not auto-merge two Form 16s.

regime_comparison.note: Old regime chosen for HRA + 80C + 80D. If computed correctly (single Rs 50,000 standard deduction, not one per employer), old regime tax is Rs 65,000. THE COMMON ERROR: naively summing both Form 16 'taxable income' figures (Rs 3,35,000 + Rs 3,65,000 = Rs 7,00,000) double-counts the standard deduction, understating tax by about Rs 10,400 -- this is exactly what triggers the 143(1) demand notice for this persona (see notices/143_1_demand_persona5.json).

erroneous_taxpayer_filed_return.description: Taxpayer sums both Form 16 std deductions (50,000+50,000=1,00,000) instead of allowing only one

cpc_recomputation_143_1.adjustment: CPC disallows the extra Rs 50,000 standard deduction (system allows only one per PAN per year)

correct_outcome_if_filed_properly.note: Even filed correctly, TDS Rs 15,000 is well short of the correct Rs 65,370 liability (both employers under-withheld because each only saw its own 6-month income) -- self-assessment tax of roughly Rs 50,370 plus interest is due regardless of the standard-deduction error.

expected_preflight_findings.message: Two Form 16s both claim a full standard deduction. Only Rs 50,000 (old regime) / Rs 75,000 (new regime) is allowed per person per year, not once per employer. Combine salary income manually before entering it.

Combined TDS from both employers (Rs 15,000) is far below the correct tax liability (~Rs 65,370) because neither employer accounted for the other's income -- expect a significant self-assessment tax payment, not a refund.
AIS correctly shows two separate 192 salary entries (Rs 5,00,000 and Rs 5,50,000); combine them into a single 'Salary' schedule with multiple employer rows in the ITR.
Return is not valid until e-Verified within 30 days of filing.

expected_ais_mismatches.note: Not strictly an AIS mismatch but a cross-Form-16 reconciliation error -- the two Form 16 'taxable income as per employer' figures cannot simply be added; the standard deduction must be applied only once when merging.
